verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own invoice payment automation with approval flows, smart invoice scanning to capture recipient details, and bill-pay invoice review via MCP. That covers the routing-for-payment part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows invoice-to-purchase-order matching or automated GL/expense coding of invoices. Missing for 10: PO matching, automated invoice coding, detailed docs on approval routing rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor invoices automatically matched to purchase orders, coded, and routed for payment

citations.quote: Automate invoice payments and approval flows
automate the process through smart invoice scanning technology
Pay vendors and handle bills — review bill pay invoices, manage vendors and their payment details
